title: Has Basin Output Faucet Depot
description:
添加了2种自动输出产物的置物台。
Add 2 auto output product depot.
body:
本模组为机械动力附属模组，添加了2种自动输出产物的置物台。
This mod is create addon, Add 2 auto output product depot.

![工作盆输出口](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/13a056cec46cb55b9d86db22d696156fb0a24bea.png)
![创造模式物品栏](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c5c81c16f3d84af81519b8624d712461147d2a2_0.webp)

与传统的自动化产线相比，其省略了传动结构和物流部件，大量堆叠产线时，其性能上会表现更优，且堆叠体积更小。
Compared to traditional automated production lines, it eliminates transmission structures and logistics components, resulting in superior performance and smaller stacking volume when deployed in large-scale production lines.
![产线堆叠](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dfeb5779950bf129a8476d8b407369f7f6b2f729.png)
